title: Gabor Frame Regions and Non-Frame Obstructions for an even Rational Window
summary: We study the Gabor frame properties of the rational window $$ g(x)=\frac{x^2-1}{(x^2+1)(x^2+4)(x^2+9)}, $$ whose poles occur in symmetric pairs. We prove that every lattice satisfying $0<αβ<1/3$ generates a frame, and we establish an additional frame region for $β\ge1$ and $1/3\le αβ<0.47373$. Furthermore, we show that the rational hyperbolas $αβ=\frac{p}{3p-1}$, for $p\ge2,$ are entirely contained within the frame set.
